title: webpack@2.1.0-beta.8 SyntaxError because of extra paren
body:
Code in question:

``` js

    import cls from 'classnames';

    // ...
    const dropdownClassName = cls({
      [baseClassName]: true,
      [`${baseClassName}_is-open`]: uiState.isOpen,
      [`${baseClassName}_is-selected`]: isSelected,
      [`${baseClassName}_is-invalid`]: canShowErrors && !isValid,
      [`${baseClassName}_is-valid`]: canShowValid && isValid,
      [`${baseClassName}_is-filled`]: Boolean(this.getValue()),
    });
```

After `beta.8` there is `SyntaxError: Unexpected )` (note 1 opening paren and 2 closing ones):

``` js
var dropdownClassName = /* harmony import */ __WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2_classnames___default.a.call(
  undefined,
  _cls = {},
  _cls[baseClassName] = true,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-open'] = uiState.isOpen,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-selected'] = isSelected,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-invalid'] = canShowErrors && !isValid,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-valid'] = canShowValid && isValid,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-filled'] = Boolean(this.getValue()),
  _cls
));
```

After `beta.7` everything is fine (2 opening and 2 closing parens):

``` js
var dropdownClassName = /* harmony import */ __WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2_classnames___default.a.bind()((
  _cls = {},
  _cls[baseClassName] = true,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-open'] = uiState.isOpen,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-selected'] = isSelected,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-invalid'] = canShowErrors && !isValid,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-valid'] = canShowValid && isValid,
  _cls[baseClassName + '_is-filled'] = Boolean(this.getValue()),
  _cls
));
```

Code was run through `babel` with this `.babelrc`
